$comment: Ready-made Paper MCP calls per sweep. Fill <fileId> and any <angle-bracket> value from the records, then send every phase-B call in ONE message. Replace nothing else. `parallel: false` means one call per message, alone.

calls.note: Once. Yields the board inventory, root frame widths and positions, and every node id phase C needs.
Read before raising anything; every candidate finding is checked against these.
One call per word the records rule out. Expect zero.
One call per semantic token: destructive, warning, success, muted-foreground and the rest the theme declares. The result is the usage map sweeps 14 and 16 read.
One call per suspect family: system-ui, -apple-system, Arial, Helvetica, Inter, and any family the type system does not name. Expect zero, or the clock node alone.
A token-bound value reports as var(--…), so a px match is a literal.
One call per placeholder fact: the sample user's name, email, code, organisation. Compare the returned spellings across boards.
One call per screen board, from the phase A inventory. Skip furniture, stickies and record boards. Answers sweeps 3, 4, 5, 6, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 21, 23.
The contract the glyphs are measured against, and the source for sweeps 17 and 23.
Only for a value the JSX leaves ambiguous.
One hero board per band, then every board a phase C finding names. One call per message, after phase C.
